messages:
sam.k: Created RC from main -> tag `v2026.03.20-rc12`. Candidate build 12 passed unit + integ. Planning DB schema migration in maintenance window at 02:00 UTC. Need ops and SRE signoff for lock and rollout plan.

maria: Thanks — what's the downtime expectation for the migration? Any backfill needed?

sam.k: Short write lock ~3m for the ALTERs, followed by async backfill that can run while prod serves reads. We'll enable read-only for affected tables for 5m during the lock. No customer-facing downtime expected beyond a few seconds for writes.

alex: Can we pin the artifact SHA in the RC manifest? I see build 12 at `sha:abc123def`. Please pin so promote -> prod uses exact artifact.

jen: Adding rollback checklist: 1) revert DB to pre-migration by restoring snapshot if migration fails 2) rollback service to `v2026.03.19-stable` (keep hotfix branch ready) 3) unblock write traffic. Who has snapshot perms? :eyes:

infra: I've created a snapshot job and validated restore runbook. Snapshot ID `snap-20260320-rc12`. Infra will hold the lock request until SRE gives green.

sre-oncall: Oncall ok with window. Need canary traffic gating: start 2% for 5m -> 10% for 10m -> 100% if no errors. Also add 10-minute abort timer on error spikes.

product-ops: Product aware. We'll post scheduled maintenance notice to status page at T-30m.

deploy-bot: Candidate build report: build=12, tests=passed, image=registry.redwood/serving:v2026.03.20-rc12, vuln-scan=low. Promotion allowed when channel signoff present.

sam.k: Proposed execution plan: 01:50 UTC — freeze configs and disable nonessential jobs; 01:55 UTC — enable read-only on affected tables; 02:00 UTC — apply schema migration (expected lock 3m); 02:05 UTC — start async backfill ops; 02:10 UTC — start canary traffic 2% per SRE policy; 02:30 UTC — evaluate metrics and escalate if errors. Pin artifact to `sha:abc123def` before promote.

maria: I approve the plan provided infra has snapshot and SRE does canary gating. :thumbsup:

alex: Pin done in release manifest: `artifact_sha: abc123def` and pushed to release bucket.

infra: Snapshot verified. Read-only toggle script: `scripts/lock_tables.sh --tables users,orders --mode ro`. I ran in staging.

jen: Rollback owner assigned: jen.heller. Revert playbook live at `docs/rollbacks/rc12-playbook.md`.

sre-oncall: SRE signoff given. Will run canary gates and watch tail error budget.

sam.k: All signoffs present. Scheduling promotion now. deploy-bot, please schedule promotion to prod at 02:00 UTC with gated canary.

deploy-bot: Promotion scheduled: `v2026.03.20-rc12` -> prod at 02:00 UTC. Canary policy: 2/5/100, abort-on-error-threshold=3% 10m. Notify thread on start/complete/failure.

product-ops: Status page update queued for T-30m. Message ready: "Planned maintenance for schema upgrade. No expected customer downtime for reads. Writes may be briefly paused."

sam.k: Thanks everyone. Will monitor dashboards and post logs here. If anything abnormal, abort and rollback per playbook.

deploy-bot: Promotion started (02:00 UTC). Canary deployed to 2% nodes.

deploy-bot: Canary health ok at 5m. Increasing to 10%.

deploy-bot: Canary health ok at 15m. Increasing to 100% and completing promotion.

deploy-bot: Promotion complete. Prod now running `v2026.03.20-rc12` (sha:abc123def).

sam.k: Post-deploy checks green, async backfill running, no errors. Closing thread and updating release notes. :tada:
